name: MonarchStackedProportionBar
title: StackedProportionBar
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.Canvas (clipPath and drawRect) for the bar and androidx.compose.foundation.layout.FlowRow for the legend, with the chart legend's square markers
summary: One horizontal bar split into proportions, with a legend that lists each part's value and share.
whenToUse: For the make-up of one total in a small space, such as a pipeline by stage, storage by type with free space, or monitors by state.
whenNotToUse: To compare parts precisely or rank many of them, use MonarchBarList; for one part of a whole, MonarchProgress or MonarchUsageMeter; for a featured share chart, MonarchDonutChart.
api: @Composable fun MonarchStackedProportionBar(label: String, segments: List<MonarchStackedProportionBarSegment>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, total: Double? = null, remainderLabel: String? = null, legendContent: MonarchStackedProportionBarLegendContent = MonarchStackedProportionBarLegendContent.Both, size: MonarchStackedProportionBarSize = MonarchStackedProportionBarSize.Md, showLegend: Boolean = true, hideZero: Boolean = true, percentDigits: Int = 0, emptyLabel: String? = null, formatValue: ((Double) -> String)? = null)
class MonarchStackedProportionBarSegment(key: String, label: String, value: Double, color: MonarchChartColor? = null)
class MonarchStackedProportionBarSegment(key: String, label: String, value: Double, tone: MonarchTone)
enum class MonarchStackedProportionBarSize { Sm, Md, Lg }
enum class MonarchStackedProportionBarLegendContent { Both, Value, Percent, None }

options.name: label
options.description: Names the bar and its legend for TalkBack, such as "Lead pipeline".

options.name: segments
options.description: The parts, in display order. Each has a key, a label, a value, and a palette color or a status tone.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the bar and legend.

options.name: total
options.description: The size of the whole, for a capacity. The sum of the parts when null or smaller than the sum; the rest is empty track.

options.name: remainderLabel
options.description: The legend name of the empty rest, such as "Free". Without it the rest is drawn but not listed.

options.name: legendContent
options.description: What each legend entry shows after its label: Both ("1,204 · 34%"), Value, Percent or None.

options.name: size
options.description: The thickness of the bar: Sm 4dp, Md 8dp or Lg 12dp.

options.name: showLegend
options.description: Whether the legend is drawn. Without it TalkBack still reads every part from the bar.

options.name: hideZero
options.description: Whether parts with a value of 0 are left out of the bar and the legend.

options.name: percentDigits
options.description: The decimal places of shares. Shares too small to write read "<1%".

options.name: emptyLabel
options.description: Replaces "No data yet", shown when no part has a value.

options.name: formatValue
options.description: Writes a value. A number in the current locale by default.

states.name: default
states.description: The parts in palette colors, in order from the start edge, each at least 4dp wide with 2dp gaps, in a rounded track; the legend lists every part.

states.name: status mode
states.description: Every segment has a tone: parts and markers take the solid color of their tone, and Neutral the subtle text color.

states.name: remainder
states.description: A total above the sum leaves empty track; with remainderLabel it is listed with an outlined marker.

states.name: legend hidden
states.description: Only the bar is drawn; TalkBack reads the label and every part from it.

states.name: empty
states.description: No part has a value: an empty track and "No data yet".

appearance: Parts take the theme's data colors 1 to 5 in order, later ones the subtle text color, over a track in the muted background color; in status mode the success, warning, danger and info solid colors. Legend markers are squares in the part's color; the remainder's is outlined in the strong border color. Legend text is caption text in the default text color, the value in medium weight. Every color is a theme role, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes are covered.
platformNotes: Drawn with a Compose Canvas (iOS draws shapes in an HStack, the web flex boxes). The web shows a tooltip when the pointer hovers a part; touch has no hover, so, as on iOS, the legend carries every value and there is no tooltip. The web minSegmentWidth option is a fixed 4dp. A mix of tones and palette colors cannot be rejected by the type system as on the web; when not every part has a tone, tones are ignored, as the web does at run time. The web locale and valueFormat options are the current locale and formatValue. The share rule ("<1%", ">99%") is the one MonarchDonutChart uses. The parts run from the start edge, so the bar mirrors in right to left. iOS uses the same names; showsLegend and hidesZero are showLegend and hideZero, in Kotlin style.
accessibility: While the legend is shown the bar is hidden from TalkBack and the legend is a traversal group named by label.
Each legend entry is one element read as the part's name, value and share, such as "Replied 182 · 9%", whatever legendContent shows.
With showLegend off, the bar is one element named by label whose state description lists every part.
With no data, one element reads the label with "No data yet" as its state.
Every part has a text label, so no part is told apart by color alone; the remainder's marker is outlined, not filled.
Legend text scales with the font size and wraps onto more rows.
edgeCases: Negative and non-finite values count as 0.
A share under 1% reads "<1%" and one just under the whole reads ">99%" (with percentDigits, the thresholds move by the same number of places).
Many tiny parts can need more than the bar's width at their minimum; the excess is clipped by the rounded track.
Palette slots follow the segment's position before zeros are hidden, so hiding a zero part never repaints the others. Pin color when a filter can remove parts.
A total smaller than the sum is ignored.
Status mode needs a tone on every segment; a partial set of tones is ignored.

examples.title: Pipeline stages
Storage capacity with a remainder
examples.code:
MonarchStackedProportionBar(
    label = "Storage",
    segments = listOf(
        MonarchStackedProportionBarSegment("media", "Media", 42.0),
        MonarchStackedProportionBarSegment("docs", "Documents", 18.0),
    ),
    total = 100.0,
    remainderLabel = "Free",
    legendContent = MonarchStackedProportionBarLegendContent.Value,
    size = MonarchStackedProportionBarSize.Lg,
    formatValue = { "${it.toInt()} GB" },
)

examples.title: Monitors by state
examples.code:
MonarchStackedProportionBar(
    label = "Monitors",
    segments = listOf(
        MonarchStackedProportionBarSegment("up", "Operational", 41.0, MonarchTone.Success),
        MonarchStackedProportionBarSegment("slow", "Degraded", 3.0, MonarchTone.Warning),
        MonarchStackedProportionBarSegment("down", "Down", 1.0, MonarchTone.Danger),
    ),
    size = MonarchStackedProportionBarSize.Sm,
)
